children: The trade deficit in the Czech Republic widened sharply to CZK 8.5 billion in July 2026 from a downwardly revised CZK 3.5 billion in the corresponding period a year earlier.

Imports rose 5.2% year-on-year to CZK 398.7 billion, lifted by higher purchases of forestry, logging, and other services (+29.9%), fish and other fishing products (+47.6%), crude oil and natural gas (+23.7%), and metal ores (+77.2%).

Meanwhile, exports increased by 3.9% to CZK 390.2 billion, driven largely by stronger sales of agriculture, hunting, and other related products (+15.7%), tobacco products (+70.6%), textiles (+13.4%), and coke and refined petroleum products (+41.6%).
In the January–July period, the trade surplus reached CZK 94.0 billion, down by CZK 32.3 billion a year earlier, as imports outpaced exports, rising 4.1% and 2.8%, respectively.

title: Czech Republic Trade Deficit Widens Sharply
